_comment_gradient_clipping: DeepSpeed performs gradient clipping inside engine.step() driven by THIS value. NOTE: under DeepSpeed, accelerate's clip_grad_norm_ does NOT clip (it only returns the global norm), so clipping MUST come from here. scripts/train.py overrides this at runtime with --grad_clip_norm (when >0) before accelerator.prepare; this 0.0 is only the fallback when --grad_clip_norm<=0 (clipping explicitly disabled).
